context: Tests whether the agent classifies each feedback type correctly (fix a CI failure, accept a reasonable suggestion, push back on over-engineering), replies to every thread with substantive content, and pushes fixes to the same branch. The SUBSTANCE of the replies is scored — a reply that concretely references the fix or cites evidence for the decline — NOT a specific phrase literal from the release skill.

checklist.name: CI failure: fix required
checklist.description: For the CI failure (failing unit test), the guide states the test must be fixed. Does NOT suggest skipping, ignoring, deferring, or `[skip ci]`

checklist.name: Applies the reasonable suggestion
checklist.description: For the clearly-correct suggestion (simplify the nested conditional), the guide says to apply it — does NOT suggest declining it or deferring

checklist.name: Declines the over-engineered suggestion
checklist.description: For the over-engineered suggestion (unnecessary abstraction for current scope), the guide says to push back — does NOT say to blindly implement it

checklist.name: All three threads get replies
checklist.description: The guide produces a reply for EVERY thread (CI failure, accept, decline) — not two of three. An empty reply or 'no response needed' on any thread scores zero for this item

checklist.name: Accept reply references the concrete fix
checklist.description: The accept reply concretely points at where/how the fix landed (a commit sha, a commit message reference, or equivalent pointer a reader can follow). A bare 'Done', 'Resolved', 'Applied', or 'OK' scores zero — no actionable pointer. The specific phrase format is NOT scored; the substance is

checklist.name: Decline reply cites concrete evidence
checklist.description: The decline reply cites concrete evidence (file:line, spec/docs quote, linked precedent, scope constraint) for why the suggestion is being declined. A bare 'No thanks', 'Disagree', or vague 'out of scope' scores zero — the reply must hand the reviewer something they can verify. The specific phrase format is NOT scored

checklist.name: Fixes pushed to the same branch
checklist.description: The guide states any code changes go on the EXISTING feature branch of the PR, not a new branch. Opening a second PR for review fixes scores zero

checklist.name: No dangling threads before merge
checklist.description: The guide explicitly states that EVERY thread must have a reply before the PR is merged — nothing left unresolved
